course_description:
Artificial intelligence (AI) and deep learning are rapidly becoming ubiquitous parts of business processes, offerings, and strategies. This course provides students with an in depth exposure to the theory and practice of machine learning by examining real applications of these methods to business processes.

Course Changes in Response to Previous Student Feedback

Programming language changed from R to Python in response to student and industry feedback.

course_aims: This course aims to provide students with knowledge of the ethical and practical issues that can arise when applying machine learning models in a business context, along with the technical skills to develop these models using common use machine learning frameworks and the Python programming language.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the basic concepts of deep learning and AI and explain their relationship to and application in business.
Apply the methods of deep learning in a Python-based software environment, with an emphasis on artificial neural networks.
Compare and critically evaluate the various approaches to artificial neural networks and assess their value for decision making.
Develop an understanding of how deep learning will change business, government, and society, and the associated costs and benefits.

assessment_details.title: Deep Learning for Business Essay (A1)
assessment_details.task_description: The use of deep learning methods is increasingly being adopted across various sectors of the economy, and as a result, business and society are likely to undergo significant changes. In a 2000-word essay, explore how a particular business or industry is likely to respond to these changes. When analysing your case study you will need to consider both the potential benefits and the potential challenges, including ethical considerations.
